name: crew
description: The crew's workflow, owned by no role: in a GitHub repository with a crew board it points every session at the crew-workflow skill (each step through its crew command, every ticket or board write shown first, stops at In approval and Ready for Merge); in one without, the session offers to create the board. Also creates crew boards. Use when asked to do, work or ship a ticket, pick up the next issue, or create a project board.
